Interface DatabaseClient

All Superinterfaces:
ConnectionAccessor
public interface DatabaseClient extends ConnectionAccessor
A non-blocking, reactive client for performing database calls with Reactive Streams back pressure. Provides a higher level, common API over R2DBC client libraries. Propagates DataAccessException variants for errors.

使用静态工厂方法create(ConnectionFactory)或获取一个builder来创建实例。

使用示例：

ConnectionFactory factory = …

DatabaseClient client = DatabaseClient.create(factory);
Mono<Actor> actor = client.sql("select first_name, last_name from t_actor")
    .map(row -> new Actor(row.get("first_name", String.class),
         row.get("last_name", String.class)))
    .first();
Since:
5.3

    • sql

      DatabaseClient.GenericExecuteSpec sql(Supplier<String> sqlSupplier)
      Specify an SQL supplier that provides SQL to run. Contract for specifying an SQL call along with options leading to the execution. The SQL string can contain either native parameter bind markers or named parameters (for example, :foo, :bar) when NamedParameterExpander is enabled.

      接受 `PreparedOperation` 作为 SQL 和绑定 `Supplier`。

      `DatabaseClient` 实现应尽可能推迟 SQL 字符串的解析，理想情况下推迟到发生 `Subscription` 时。默认实现即为此情况。

      Parameters:
      sqlSupplier - SQL 语句的供应者
      Returns:
      一个新的DatabaseClient.GenericExecuteSpec
      See Also:
